description: Teach the agent one rule from a coaching point on a call (get_coaching gives the code and a suggested rule). The rule is added to a Coaching rules section of the agent's instructions through the governed update path, so it is versioned, in change history and can be rolled back; a business owner or admin signed in through this connector applies it right away, otherwise it waits for the owner. Then a test is built from that call and run, and the result says whether the agent now follows the rule.

business_id.description: Business ID. Required when the key can reach more than one business.

call_id.description: The call the coaching point is on.

code.description: The coaching point code from get_coaching.

rule.description: One plain instruction the agent should follow on every call (8-300 characters). Usually the suggested rule from get_coaching.

name: teach_coaching_rule
title: Teach Coaching Rule
